hints.title: Invert to Longest Subarray
hints.text: Removing elements from the ends to sum to x is equivalent to finding the longest subarray summing to total_sum minus x.

hints.title: Sliding Window for Target Sum
hints.text: Since all elements are positive, use a two-pointer sliding window to find the maximum subarray summing to target.

hints.title: Compute Result from Window Size
hints.text: The answer is total elements minus maximum window size, or negative one if no valid subarray is found.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively choosing left or right end branch creates an O(2^n) search tree.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inverting to finding the longest middle subarray allows a two-pointer window in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that non-negative numbers allow two-pointer sliding window for target = sum(nums) - x.
